item.title: Record Permission for an Everyday Photo Archive
item.audience: the coordinator of a neighbourhood photo archive
item.prompt_text: A volunteer archive wants to keep photographs of ordinary shopfronts and community events. Some photographers allow viewing in the archive but do not allow images to be posted online. Volunteers have inherited older photo envelopes with little information about permission. Propose a simple tracking system, including what to do when permission is unclear and how to resolve conflicting records.
item.target_grammar: Conditionals for workflow; nominalisation; reporting permissions with may and authorised to.
item.target_structure: Purpose → minimum record and default → conflicting evidence example → practical handover.

checklist.point: Distinguish accession, in-room viewing and online publication permissions.
Give a simple default when permission is unknown.
Show how a concrete conflict would be resolved and documented.
Give a realistic way to keep the system usable.
